trustStrip.title: All Levels
trustStrip.description: Programs designed for first-timers, novices, and intermediate players

trustStrip.title: 1-on-1 or Group Sessions
trustStrip.description: Individual lessons to help you with your specific game. Or join group skill building lessons, 3rd-shot drop clinics, etc.

trustStrip.title: East Bay Area
trustStrip.description: Serving Lafayette, Walnut Creek, Alamo, Danville, Rossmoor, Concord, Pleasant Hill, Orinda, Blackhawk, Round Hill and surrounding areas.

trustStrip.title: Guaranteed Results
trustStrip.description: We're in this to have fun and get active. With a few quick tweaks and pieces of advice, you'll be feeling more confident after your first lesson, guaranteed!

howItWorks.title: Reach out
howItWorks.description: Send a text or email with your experience level and what you'd like to work on.

howItWorks.title: Pick your format
howItWorks.description: Choose a 1-1 private lesson, a small semi-private, or a group clinic with friends.

howItWorks.title: Get on the court
howItWorks.description: We'll agree to meet on a court convenient to you in the East Bay area. Show up with a paddle, some water, and sunscreen, and enjoy strategic, encouraging coaching built around your game, needs, and goals.

whyLiftHeading: Pickleball lessons built for beginners & intermediate players who like to win — and have fun doing it

whyLiftCards.title: Build Your Game Confidence
whyLiftCards.description: Learn the shots and positioning that make you feel sure of yourself on the court. Stop hitting overheads into the net. Stop popping up easy dinks. Stop swinging at low balls.

whyLiftCards.title: Stay active & social
whyLiftCards.description: Get a fun, low-impact workout while building real friendships with other pickleballers on the court.

whyLiftCards.title: Win More Games
whyLiftCards.description: Take home practical strategy and learn new drills for doubles play.

heroSubtitle: Private and small-group pickleball lessons designed for players of all skill levels and ages who want to build confidence on the court and start winning more of their games.
whyLiftSubheading: Lift Pickleball focuses on the things that make the biggest difference for adult learners: clear technique, smart strategy, and a coaching style that is casual, yet concise.
heroTitle: Have more fun. Win more games.
